competing_explanation: An apparent recovery can arise from calibration-role overfit, a few active scenes, area-cap sparsity, seed or fold instability, score permutation artifacts, or privileged target leakage rather than a deployable low-risk tail. Conversely, a valid failure after probability-semantics and setwise controls would show that the frozen observable heads do not identify a sufficiently precise safe tail, and would justify authoring a genuinely decision-focused controller-training contract rather than another threshold or post-hoc calibration retry.
